name: TechRetail Customer Support — Release Gate
description: Regression test for TechRetail's RAG-powered customer support chatbot. Scenario: dev switched from GPT-4 to Llama-3 to save costs. This test catches hallucinated policies, missing citations, and safety violations before they reach production.

cases.question: I bought a laptop 2 weeks ago and want to return it. Can I get a full refund?
evidence: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. The product must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

cases.question: My order has been delayed for a week. What compensation do I get?
evidence: For shipping delays over 5 business days: 25% discount + free express shipping on next order. For lost orders: full refund + 15% credit.

cases.question: My phone screen cracked after I dropped it last week. Is this covered by warranty?
evidence: All TechRetail electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Extended warranty available for purchase within 30 days of purchase. Warranty covers manufacturing defects, not accidental damage.

cases.question: I want to close my account and have all my personal data deleted immediately.
evidence: Customers can request data deletion within 30 days of account closure. Personal data is retained for up to 10 years for tax compliance.

cases.question: How much do I need to spend to get Gold status in the loyalty program?
evidence: Loyalty members earn 1% cashback on all purchases. Members can upgrade to Gold (2% cashback) at $1000 annual spend. Platinum (3%) at $3000 annual spend. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity.

cases.question: Can I return a product I bought 50 days ago?
evidence: Returns are accepted within 60 days of delivery. Customers must initiate returns through the website. TechRetail provides a prepaid return label. Refund issued after we receive and inspect the returned item.

cases.question: How long does international shipping take?
evidence: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. For orders over $100, free standard shipping is provided. International orders may take 7-14 days.

cases.question: We just detected a P0 incident where the checkout API is down. What's the response time target?
evidence: P0 incidents require immediate escalation to the on-call engineering lead. Response time target is 15 minutes. All P0 incidents must be documented in the incident channel within 30 minutes of detection.
